nodes.label: GLOBAL_ALLOWLIST E2E Error Filter
nodes.rationale: Every entry must carry a comment explaining what it silences; per-spec suppressions go through the expectedErrors fixture instead of this file so allowlist drift stays visible per-PR rather than buried in shared infrastructure. Console-level 5xx echoes cannot be URL-discriminated because ConsoleMessage.text() omits the URL, so one broad pattern covers them while the paired request-level entries enforce specificity. Entries marked TODO(real-bug) track genuine mock gaps (missing /api/review, /api/stats/history, /api/event_ids, /api/sub_labels, latest.webp, jsmpeg WS) and one real accessibility bug (DialogContent without DialogTitle).
